notes: traits use the Life.relationships trait keys (0..1). weight = relative share of the 4,000 NPCs. interests feed Life.relationships.register_npc.

personalities.name: Sunny Optimist
personalities.summary: Relentlessly upbeat, sees the bright side of everything, cheers people on.

personalities.name: Dry Cynic
personalities.summary: Deadpan and sarcastic; expects the worst and is quietly loyal once you earn it.

personalities.name: Shy Bookworm
personalities.summary: Soft-spoken reader who opens up slowly and talks in book references.

personalities.name: Gym Motivator
personalities.summary: Fitness evangelist, high energy, turns every chat into a pep talk.

personalities.name: Anxious Overthinker
personalities.summary: Worries out loud, apologizes a lot, endearingly sincere.

personalities.name: Old Soul Storyteller
personalities.summary: Folksy, nostalgic, every topic reminds them of a story about the old town.

personalities.name: Ambitious Hustler
personalities.summary: Side-gig entrepreneur, networking constantly, talks in pitches.

personalities.name: Laid-back Drifter
personalities.summary: Unhurried, mellow, allergic to stress and schedules.

personalities.name: Party Animal
personalities.summary: Lives for the weekend, loud, generous, always knows where the party is.

personalities.name: Nerdy Gamer
personalities.summary: Enthusiastic about games, lore and tabletop nights; speaks in gamer slang.

personalities.name: Earnest Activist
personalities.summary: Passionate about causes, petitions and community; idealistic and warm.

personalities.name: Hopeless Romantic
personalities.summary: Dreamy, poetic, falls for people fast and believes in destiny.

personalities.name: Stoic Pragmatist
personalities.summary: Few words, practical, steady; shows care through actions.

personalities.name: Social Gossip
personalities.summary: Knows everyone's business, chatty, loves drama but means well.

personalities.name: Grumpy Curmudgeon
personalities.summary: Complains about everything, secretly soft-hearted.

personalities.name: Free-spirit Artist
personalities.summary: Whimsical painter type, sees color and meaning everywhere.

personalities.name: Type-A Perfectionist
personalities.summary: Organized, precise, slightly intense, color-codes everything.

personalities.name: Class Clown
personalities.summary: Jokes, puns and pranks; deflects seriousness with humor.

personalities.name: Gentle Caretaker
personalities.summary: Nurturing, motherly or fatherly, always offering food and advice.

personalities.name: Know-it-all Academic
personalities.summary: Pedantic, curious, corrects you kindly and loves a lecture.

personalities.name: Thrill Seeker
personalities.summary: Adrenaline junkie, dares everyone, bored by safety.

personalities.name: Spiritual Mystic
personalities.summary: Into astrology, crystals and vibes; serene and a little cryptic.

personalities.name: By-the-Book
personalities.summary: Rule follower, polite, cites policy, very trustworthy.

personalities.name: Rebel Punk
personalities.summary: Anti-authority, blunt, loyal to their crew, loves loud music.

personalities.name: Foodie
personalities.summary: Relates everything to food, restaurant critic energy, generous cook.

personalities.name: Competitive Rival
personalities.summary: Trash-talks, turns everything into a contest, respects strength.

personalities.name: Dramatic Diva
personalities.summary: Theatrical, everything is the best or worst moment of their life.

personalities.name: Literal Engineer
personalities.summary: Precise, literal-minded, explains how things work, misses sarcasm.

personalities.name: Polite Traditionalist
personalities.summary: Courteous small-town manners, sweet tea and church picnics, says ma'am and sir.

personalities.name: Mysterious Loner
personalities.summary: Cryptic, quiet, night owl; reveals depth only to the trusted few.
